A_t.en: Low-level action for one planned robot action: three numbers of movement, three Euler angles, one gripper state.
A_t.zh: 對應一個規劃動作的低層動作：三個位移、三個歐拉角、一個夾爪狀態。

Bsear.en: The Base Searcher, as spelled in print. Superscript LLM: its inputs are text only.
Bsear.zh: Base Searcher，印刷的拼法就是 Bsear。上標 LLM：輸入只有文字。

E_t.en: Edges: the action predicates between those objects in time step t. Whether it holds one edge or all edges so far is not stated.
E_t.zh: edge：時間步 t、這些物體之間的動作 predicate。裡面是一條，還是到目前為止的全部，論文沒寫。

G_nar1.en: The graph that the stage-1 output is translated into. How the two narrators' outputs are merged is not stated.
G_nar1.zh: 階段 1 的輸出轉成的圖。兩個 narrator 的輸出怎麼合併，論文沒寫。

G_t.en: The high-level task plan as a graph: the pair (N_t, E_t).
G_t.shape: pair: (set of nodes, set of edges)
G_t.zh: 寫成圖的 high-level 任務計劃：(N_t, E_t) 這一對。

Gamma_any.en: Grasp poses that AnyGrasp outputs for all observed objects, with their transformation matrix.
Gamma_any.zh: AnyGrasp 替看到的所有物體輸出的夾取姿態，附變換矩陣。

Gamma_c_b.en: Transformation from the camera to the robot base, obtained via hand-eye calibration.
Gamma_c_b.zh: 相機到機器人底座的轉換，由 hand-eye calibration 得到。

Gamma_grasp.en: The grasp poses that fall inside the target part's mask. Which one is finally used is not stated.
Gamma_grasp.zh: 落在目標零件 mask 裡的夾取姿態。最後用哪一個，論文沒寫。

Gamma_obj.en: The grasp pose of the part in what the paper calls world coordinates: Γ_obj = Γ^c_b × Γ_grasp.
Gamma_obj.zh: 零件的夾取姿態，論文稱在 world 座標：Γ_obj = Γ^c_b × Γ_grasp。

Gamma_t.en: Camera pose at frame t: maps camera coordinates to the common reference frame.
Gamma_t.zh: 畫面 t 的相機姿態：把相機座標換到共同參考座標。

I_depth.en: The depth image in one observation: one distance per pixel. The paper writes the shape h×w and does not state the unit. The lab image is 640×480, metres along the optical axis.
I_depth.zh: 一次觀測裡的深度影像：每個 pixel 一個距離。論文寫的形狀是 h×w，沒有寫單位。實驗室的影像是 640×480，沿光軸量，單位公尺。

I_rgb.en: The colour image in one observation. The paper writes the shape h×w×3 and does not state h, w, or what the 3 stands for. The lab image is 640×480.
I_rgb.zh: 一次觀測裡的彩色影像。論文寫的形狀是 h×w×3，沒有寫 h、w，也沒有寫那個 3 是什麼。實驗室的影像是 640×480。

I_rgb_j.en: Colour value of pixel (u, v) in view j. In Eq. (6) it is tested against the mask, which does not fit by type.
I_rgb_j.zh: 視角 j 裡 pixel (u, v) 的顏色值。式 (6) 拿它去比 mask，型別對不上。

K.en: Camera intrinsic matrix. Values not stated in the paper; the lab uses f = 385 px and centre (320, 240) px.
K.src: Eq. (4), p.4 right; lab values are Demo
K.zh: 相機的 intrinsic matrix。論文沒有印數值；實驗室用 f = 385 px、中心 (320, 240) px。

K_inv.en: The inverse of K: it undoes K. Applied to [u, v, 1] it gives the ray direction ((u − c_x)/f_x, (v − c_y)/f_y, 1), with no unit. Multiplying by depth then gives the point.
K_inv.zh: K 的反矩陣：把 K 做的事倒回去。乘上 [u, v, 1] 得到射線方向 ((u − c_x)/f_x, (v − c_y)/f_y, 1)，沒有單位。再乘深度就得到那個點。

Longrightarrow.en: Printed between the two sides of Eq. (2). Not defined in the paper; read here as “produces”.
Longrightarrow.zh: 印在式 (2) 兩邊之間。論文沒有定義；這裡讀成「產生」。

M_tasks.en: Number of tasks averaged in mR. What one task is, the paper does not state; the data set has 127 drawings.
M_tasks.zh: mR 平均的任務數。一個任務指什麼，論文沒寫；資料集有 127 張組裝圖。

N_points.en: Number of points of the disassembled cloud. The centroid divides by N and the ICP sum runs over i = 1 … N. Not the node set N_t.
N_points.zh: 拆開那團點雲的點數。質心除以 N，ICP 的總和從 i = 1 加到 N。不是 node 的集合 N_t。

N_t.en: Nodes: the sets of objects in the triples.
N_t.zh: node：triple 裡的物體所成的集合。

Nar1_short.en: The stage-1 narrator written as one function. The text has two agents, Relation Narrator and Image Narrator.
Nar1_short.zh: 階段 1 的 narrator，寫成一個函數。正文其實有兩個 agent：Relation Narrator 和 Image Narrator。

Nar_1.en: The stage-1 narrator, written as one function. The text describes two agents, Relation Narrator and Image Narrator.
Nar_1.shape: function: picture and text in, text out
Nar_1.zh: 階段 1 的 narrator，式子寫成一個函數。正文描述的是兩個 agent：Relation Narrator 與 Image Narrator。

Nar_2.en: The stage-2 narrator, called Action Narrator in the text. Superscript VLM: the call receives the picture.
Nar_2.shape: function: picture and text in, text out
Nar_2.zh: 階段 2 的 narrator，正文叫 Action Narrator。上標 VLM：這次呼叫有拿到圖。

O_dis.en: Observations of the disassembly states of the η parts, each from k views.
O_dis.zh: η 個零件拆開狀態的觀測，各 k 個視角。

O_s.en: Observations of the assembly states of the η parts, each from k views. Where they come from is not stated.
O_s.zh: η 個零件組好狀態的觀測，各 k 個視角。怎麼取得，論文沒寫。

O_t.en: One observation at time t: a colour image and a depth map. The paper later reuses O_t for a set of k images.
O_t.zh: 時間 t 的一次觀測：一張彩色影像加一張 depth map。論文後面又把 O_t 拿來指 k 張影像的集合。

P_bold_t.en: Called the homogeneous matrix in the paper. For the product with Γ_t to be a point it must be [P_t; 1], a 4×1 vector (my reading).
P_bold_t.zh: 論文稱 homogeneous matrix。要和 Γ_t 乘出一個點，它得是 [P_t; 1]，4×1 的向量（我的讀法）。

P_cal_i.en: Point cloud of part i, merged from k views. Printed as p_i inside ζ_i.
P_cal_i.zh: 零件 i 的點雲，由 k 個視角合併。在 ζ_i 裡印成 p_i。

P_i_alone.en: Spatial relation stored for part i: the pair {R, T}. Not a point and not a point cloud.
P_i_alone.zh: 替零件 i 存下的空間關係：{R, T} 這一對。不是點，也不是點雲。

P_i_memory.en: The spatial relation stored for part i: one rotation and one translation between its disassembly and assembly states. Not a point and not a point cloud.
P_i_memory.zh: 替零件 i 存下的空間關係：拆開狀態和組好狀態之間的一個旋轉加一個平移。不是點，也不是點雲。

P_t.en: 3D point of pixel (u, v) in the camera frame.
P_t.zh: pixel (u, v) 在相機座標裡的 3D 點。

P_t_short.en: The 3D point in camera coordinates from Eq. (4), written without (u, v) in the worked example.
P_t_short.zh: 式 (4) 得到、在相機座標裡的 3D 點，例子裡省略了 (u, v)。

P_vec.en: The adjacent gripper location where the approach of Eq. (7) starts. Which point exactly is not stated.
P_vec.zh: 式 (7) 進場起點的鄰近夾爪位置。確切是哪一點，論文沒寫。

P_w_t.en: The same point in the common reference frame. Which frame that is, the paper does not state.
P_w_t.zh: 同一個點在共同參考座標裡的位置。是哪一個座標，論文沒寫。

Pr_x.en: Probability of the table whose first count is x, when the successes are dealt at random. Pr(a) is the probability of the table we actually saw; for Product 5, Pr(7) = 0.0106.
Pr_x.zh: 第一格是 x 的那張表出現的機率（成功次數隨機分配時）。Pr(a) 是實際看到的那張表的機率；Product 5 的 Pr(7) = 0.0106。

Prompt.en: The instruction text for this call.
Prompt.zh: 這次呼叫用的指示文字。

R0_vec.en: The orientation the gripper arrives with, before it turns to the grasp orientation R. Our reading of the second waypoint; the paper does not name it.
R0_vec.zh: 夾爪進場時的朝向，還沒轉到夾取朝向 R 之前。這是我們對第二個路點的讀法；論文沒有替它取名字。

R3.en: Lists of three real numbers. T ∈ ℝ^3 means T has three numbers, one per axis.
R3.zh: 三個實數排成的串。T ∈ ℝ^3 表示 T 有三個數，一個軸一個。

R7.en: Lists of seven real numbers. A_t has seven: dx, dy, dz, rx, ry, rz and s_t.
R7.zh: 七個實數排成的串。A_t 有七個：dx、dy、dz、rx、ry、rz、s_t。

RMSE_sym.en: Root mean square error of the matched pairs: the ICP sum divided by N, then the square root. Not in the paper.
RMSE_sym.zh: 配對點的均方根誤差：ICP 的總和除以 N，再開根號。論文沒有。

R_at_k.en: Recall at level k for one task: hits over answers. Not the rotation matrix R of §3.2.
R_at_k.zh: 一個任務在層級 k 的 Recall：命中數除以答案數。不是 §3.2 的旋轉矩陣 R。

R_grasp.en: The rotation part of Γ_grasp: the orientation the gripper must have to hold the part. Used in the 'gripper turned' reading of the second waypoint.
R_grasp.zh: Γ_grasp 的旋轉部分：夾爪要夾住零件所需的朝向。用在第二個路點「只轉向」的讀法。

R_m.en: Recall of task m at level k. mR@k is the average of these over the M tasks.
R_m.zh: 任務 m 在層級 k 的 Recall。mR@k 是 M 個任務的這個值取平均。

R_rot.en: Rotation matrix in SO(3). Not Recall (§4.1) and not the Euler-angle vector of Eq. (7).
R_rot.zh: SO(3) 裡的旋轉矩陣。不是 Recall（§4.1），也不是式 (7) 的歐拉角向量。

R_vec.en: Gripper rotation [rx, ry, rz] in Euler angles, derived from Γ_obj. Not the 3×3 matrix R of the memory and not Recall.
R_vec.zh: 夾爪的旋轉 [rx, ry, rz]，歐拉角，由 Γ_obj 得來。不是記憶裡的 3×3 矩陣 R，也不是 Recall。

SO3.en: The set of all 3D rotation matrices. R ∈ SO(3) says R is a proper rotation: R^T R = I and det R = 1.
SO3.zh: 所有 3D 旋轉矩陣的集合。R ∈ SO(3) 表示 R 是旋轉：R^T R = I 且 det R = 1。

T_rou.en: Rough translation vector. The paper bases it on the distance between the two centroids; read here as their difference.
T_rou.zh: 粗平移向量。論文說由兩個質心的距離算出；這裡讀成兩個質心的差。

T_trans.en: Translation, a column vector. Not the time index t and not the gripper move of Eq. (7).
T_trans.zh: 平移，行向量。不是時間下標 t，也不是式 (7) 的夾爪位移。

T_vec.en: Gripper movement [dx, dy, dz] in Cartesian space, derived from Γ_obj. Not the translation T that ICP returns.
T_vec.zh: 夾爪在笛卡兒空間的位移 [dx, dy, dz]，由 Γ_obj 得來。不是 ICP 給的平移 T。

alpha_half.en: Probability allowed in each tail: α/2 = 0.025 for a 95% interval.
alpha_half.zh: 每一尾允許的機率：95% 區間時 α/2 = 0.025。

blacktriangleright.en: Marker in our lab panel: the waypoint the gripper is at now. Not in the paper.
blacktriangleright.zh: 我們實驗室面板上的記號：夾爪現在走到的路點。論文沒有。

c08.en: Fraction of T for the third waypoint, P + 0.8 T. The paper prints it in Eq. (7) and gives no reason for the value.
c08.zh: 第三個路點 P + 0.8 T 裡 T 的比例。論文在式 (7) 印出這個數，沒有說明為什麼是這個值。

c092.en: Fraction of T for the fourth waypoint, P + 0.92 T. The step from 0.8 to 0.92 is 0.12 T. The paper gives no reason for the value.
c092.zh: 第四個路點 P + 0.92 T 裡 T 的比例。從 0.8 到 0.92 這一段是 0.12 T。論文沒有說明為什麼是這個值。

c096.en: Fraction of T for the fifth waypoint, P + 0.96 T. The last two steps are 0.04 T each. The paper gives no reason for the value.
c096.zh: 第五個路點 P + 0.96 T 裡 T 的比例。最後兩段各 0.04 T。論文沒有說明為什麼是這個值。

c_bar_dis.en: Centroid of the disassembled-state cloud ζ_{i,dis}. The symbol is ours.
c_bar_dis.src: §3.2, p.4 right (the centroids); the symbol is ours
c_bar_dis.zh: 拆開狀態點雲 ζ_{i,dis} 的質心。符號是我們的。

c_bar_pair.en: The two centroids: assembled (s) and disassembled (dis). T_rou is their difference.
c_bar_pair.src: §3.2, p.4 right (the centroids); the symbols are ours
c_bar_pair.zh: 兩個質心：組好的（s）和拆開的（dis）。T_rou 是它們的差。

c_bar_s.en: Centroid of the assembled-state cloud ζ_{i,s}. The paper names the centroids; the symbol is ours.
c_bar_s.src: §3.2, p.4 right (the centroids); the symbol is ours
c_bar_s.zh: 組好狀態點雲 ζ_{i,s} 的質心。論文提到了質心；這個符號是我們的。

c_i.en: Label and bounding box of part i from Grounding DINO. One symbol holds both.
c_i.zh: Grounding DINO 給零件 i 的標籤和 bounding box。一個符號裝了兩樣東西。

c_x.en: Image centre, x part: the column where the optical axis meets the image. Not printed in the paper. Worked example 50 px; our lab 320 px.
c_x.zh: 影像中心的 x：光軸穿過影像的那一欄。論文沒有印。例子 50 px，我們的實驗室 320 px。

c_y.en: Image centre, y part: the row where the optical axis meets the image. Not printed in the paper. Worked example 40 px; our lab 240 px.
c_y.zh: 影像中心的 y：光軸穿過影像的那一列。論文沒有印。例子 40 px，我們的實驗室 240 px。

cdot.en: Multiplication dot. In Eq. (4) it scales the vector K^{-1} p by the depth d. In Eq. (5) it is a matrix times a vector.
cdot.zh: 乘號。式 (4) 用它把向量 K^{-1} p 乘上深度 d；式 (5) 是矩陣乘向量。

d_t.en: Depth value at pixel (u, v) in frame t. Unit not stated; metres in the lab.
d_t.zh: 畫面 t 裡 pixel (u, v) 的深度值。論文沒寫單位；實驗室用公尺。

dxyz.en: Gripper movement along x, along y and along z: the three numbers of T. Taken from Γ_obj. The paper gives no unit; our lab uses metres.
dxyz.zh: 夾爪沿 x、沿 y、沿 z 的位移：T 的三個數。取自 Γ_obj。論文沒有寫單位；我們的實驗室用公尺。

epsilon.en: The part list. Under Eq. (1) it is called examples in the part list; §3.1 describes names and quantities.
epsilon.zh: part list。式 (1) 下方稱為 examples in the part list；§3.1 說的是名稱與數量。

eq7_coeffs.en: Fixed fractions of T in Eq. (7). No source or sensitivity test is given.
eq7_coeffs.zh: 式 (7) 裡 T 的固定比例。沒有來源，也沒有敏感度測試。

eta.en: Number of mechanical parts; i runs from 1 to η.
eta.zh: 機械零件的個數；i 從 1 到 η。

ex_004.en: Worked example: 0.8 × 0.05 m: the shift of the y coordinate at the third waypoint.
ex_004.zh: 例子：0.8 × 0.05 m，第三個路點 y 座標的位移。

ex_0096.en: Worked example: 0.8 × 0.12 m: the drop of the z coordinate at the third waypoint, since T_z = −0.12 m.
ex_0096.zh: 例子：0.8 × 0.12 m，第三個路點 z 座標下降的量，因為 T_z = −0.12 m。

ex_02.en: Worked example: 20 px / 100 px = 0.2. It is the x and y part of the ray direction through the pixel, with no unit.
ex_02.zh: 例子：20 px / 100 px = 0.2。是穿過這個 pixel 的射線方向的 x、y 分量，沒有單位。

ex_04.en: Worked example: depth 2 m times 0.2 = 0.4 m. It is the x and y of the 3D point.
ex_04.zh: 例子：深度 2 m 乘 0.2 = 0.4 m。是 3D 點的 x 和 y。

ex_100.en: Worked example: f_x = f_y = 100 px. It is the denominator of (u − c_x)/f_x and (v − c_y)/f_y.
ex_100.zh: 例子：f_x = f_y = 100 px。它是 (u − c_x)/f_x 和 (v − c_y)/f_y 的分母。

ex_14.en: Worked example: x = 0.4 m plus the 1 m shift of Γ_t along x.
ex_14.zh: 例子：x = 0.4 m 加上 Γ_t 沿 x 的 1 m 平移。

ex_2.en: Worked example: depth d = 2 m. It is also the z of the 3D point.
ex_2.zh: 例子：深度 d = 2 m。也是 3D 點的 z。

ex_40.en: Worked example: image centre c_y = 40 px, so 60 − 40 = 20 px.
ex_40.zh: 例子：影像中心 c_y = 40 px，所以 60 − 40 = 20 px。

ex_50.en: Worked example: image centre c_x = 50 px, so 70 − 50 = 20 px.
ex_50.zh: 例子：影像中心 c_x = 50 px，所以 70 − 50 = 20 px。

ex_60.en: Worked example: pixel row v = 60 px.
ex_60.zh: 例子：pixel 的列 v = 60 px。

ex_70.en: Worked example: pixel column u = 70 px (our own numbers, not the paper's).
ex_70.zh: 例子：pixel 的欄 u = 70 px（我們自己取的數，不是論文的）。

f_0106.en: Chance of exactly this table: 77520 × 15504 ÷ 113380261800 ≈ 0.0106. Our calculation.

f_15.en: 15 = a + c − x = 22 − 7: successes left for the 'with base' group. It equals c for Product 5.
f_15.zh: 15 = a + c − x = 22 − 7：留給「有 base」那組的成功次數。Product 5 剛好等於 c。

f_20.en: Trials per group: 20 for each product, with and without the base (Table 2).
f_20.zh: 每組的試驗次數：每件產品有 base、沒有 base 各 20 次（表 2）。

f_7.en: Product 5 without base: 7 successes out of 20 (Table 2). This is a in Pr(7).
f_7.zh: Product 5 沒有 base：20 次成功 7 次（表 2）。就是 Pr(7) 裡的 a。

f_x.en: Focal length along x, in pixels, not millimetres. The paper prints no value. The worked example uses 100 px; our lab uses 385 px.
f_x.zh: x 方向的焦距，單位是 pixel，不是毫米。論文沒有印數值。例子用 100 px，我們的實驗室用 385 px。

f_y.en: Focal length along y, in pixels. The paper prints no value. The worked example uses 100 px; our lab uses 385 px.
f_y.zh: y 方向的焦距，單位是 pixel。論文沒有印數值。例子用 100 px，我們的實驗室用 385 px。

fisher_ab.en: a successes and b failures without the Base Searcher, out of 20 trials. Product 5: a = 7, b = 13 (Table 2).
fisher_ab.zh: 沒有 Base Searcher 時，20 次裡 a 次成功、b 次失敗。Product 5：a = 7、b = 13（表 2）。

fisher_cd.en: c successes and d failures with the Base Searcher, out of 20 trials. Product 5: c = 15, d = 5 (Table 2).
fisher_cd.zh: 有 Base Searcher 時，20 次裡 c 次成功、d 次失敗。Product 5：c = 15、d = 5（表 2）。

h_img.en: Image height in pixels. The paper gives no value; our lab uses 480.
h_img.zh: 影像高度，單位 pixel。論文沒有給數值；我們的實驗室用 480。

hits.en: Number of predicted triples that match an answer at the chosen level. R = hits / n_gt. Extra wrong triples do not change it.
hits.zh: 預測的 triple 中，在選定層級上和答案對上的條數。R = hits / n_gt。多寫的錯 triple 不會改變它。

i_action.en: The i of A^i_t. The paper does not say what i counts; I read it as the number of the planned action.
i_action.src: §3.2, p.5 left; the paper does not define i
i_action.zh: A^i_t 的 i。論文沒有說 i 在數什麼；我讀成第幾個規劃動作。

i_part.en: Part number, from 1 to η, in c_i, m_i and the point cloud of part i.
i_part.zh: 零件編號，從 1 到 η，用在 c_i、m_i 和零件 i 的點雲。

i_point.en: Point number, from 1 to N, in the centroid and ICP sums. In ζ_i the i counts parts.
i_point.zh: 點的編號，從 1 到 N，用在質心和 ICP 的總和裡。ζ_i 裡的 i 數的是零件。

i_set.en: The condition in Eq. (3) that selects steps. The set is not defined in the paper.
i_set.zh: 式 (3) 裡挑選步驟的條件。這個集合論文沒有定義。

i_step.en: Step number in Eq. (1), from 1 to κ. In §3.2 the same letter numbers the parts, from 1 to η.
i_step.zh: 式 (1) 的步驟編號，1 到 κ。§3.2 用同一個字母編零件，1 到 η。

i_sum_ci.en: Summation index: the number of successes counted in the binomial sum, from k to n in the lower-end equation and from 0 to k in the upper-end equation.
i_sum_ci.zh: 加總的指標：二項分配裡被計入的成功次數，下限那條式子從 k 加到 n，上限那條從 0 加到 k。

in.en: 'Is an element of'. i ∈ {σ→ϱ}: step i is on the path. k ∈ {Triple, Pair, Action}: the level is one of three. (u, v) ∈ m_i: the pixel lies in the mask. R ∈ SO(3): R is a rotation. A ∈ ℝ^7: A has seven numbers.
in.src: Eq. (3), p.3 right; Eq. (6), p.4 right; §3.2, p.4 right and p.5 left
in.zh: 「屬於」。i ∈ {σ→ϱ}：第 i 步在這條路徑上。k ∈ {Triple, Pair, Action}：層級是三種之一。(u, v) ∈ m_i：這個 pixel 落在 mask 裡。R ∈ SO(3)：R 是旋轉。A ∈ ℝ^7：A 有七個數。

j_view.en: View number, from 1 to k. Eq. (4) and (5) write t in the same place. Not the j of r_j in KP 04.
j_view.zh: 視角編號，從 1 到 k。式 (4)(5) 同一個位置寫的是 t。不是 KP 04 r_j 的 j。

k_level.en: Match level: Triple, Pair or Action. Not the number of camera views in Eq. (6).
k_level.zh: 比對層級：Triple、Pair 或 Action。不是式 (6) 的相機視角數。

k_success.en: Number of successful trials out of n. Not the number of camera views of Eq. (6).
k_success.zh: n 次裡成功的次數。不是式 (6) 的相機視角數。

k_views.en: Number of camera views per observation. Value not stated; default 3 in the lab.
k_views.zh: 每次觀測的相機視角數。論文沒寫數值；實驗室預設 3。

kappa.en: Number of assembly steps. No value is given for any product.
kappa.zh: 組裝步驟的數目。論文沒有給任何產品的值。

key_levels.en: Which fields must be equal for a hit: Triple (s, p, o), Pair (s, o), Action (p, {s, o}). This is our reading of the paper's three names.
key_levels.zh: 命中時哪幾格要相同：Triple 是 (s, p, o)，Pair 是 (s, o)，Action 是 (p, {s, o})。這是我們對論文三個名字的讀法。

langle.en: Angle brackets: an ordered list. Eq. (7) lists six waypoints in order. The paper also uses them for triples ⟨subject, predicate, object⟩.
langle.zh: 角括號：有順序的一串。式 (7) 依序列出六個路點。論文也拿它寫 triple ⟨subject, predicate, object⟩。

le.en: Less than or equal to. In the p sum, add every table with Pr(x) ≤ Pr(a): no more likely than the observed one.
le.zh: 小於或等於。算 p 時，把 Pr(x) ≤ Pr(a) 的表全部加起來：機率不高於實際觀察到的那張。

level_names.en: The three match levels of the paper: Triple (whole triple), Pair (the two objects), Action (objects and relation).
level_names.zh: 論文的三個比對層級：Triple（整條）、Pair（兩個物體）、Action（物體加關係）。

lnorm.en: Double bars: the length of a vector. ‖R p_i + T − q_i‖ is the distance between the moved point and its partner; ‖T_rou‖ is the length of the rough shift.
lnorm.zh: 雙線：向量的長度。‖R p_i + T − q_i‖ 是搬動後的點和它的配對點的距離；‖T_rou‖ 是粗平移的長度。

lvert.en: Single bars: the number of items in a set. |match_k| is the number of hits, |T*| the number of answer triples, |𝒫_i| the number of points of a cloud.
lvert.zh: 單線：集合裡有幾個東西。|match_k| 是命中數，|T*| 是答案 triple 的條數，|𝒫_i| 是一團點雲的點數。

mR_at_k.en: Mean of the per-task R@k values.
mR_at_k.zh: 各任務 R@k 的平均。

m_i.en: Mask of part i from GroundedSAM-v2: the pixels that lie on the part. The paper calls it a semantic feature.
m_i.zh: GroundedSAM-v2 給零件 i 的 mask：落在零件上的那些 pixel。論文把它叫 semantic feature。

m_ij.en: Mask of part i in view j. This is our reading: the printed Eq. (6) writes m_i with no view index, though each view has its own mask.
m_ij.zh: 零件 i 在視角 j 的 mask。這是我們的讀法：式 (6) 印的是沒有視角下標的 m_i，但每個視角各有一張 mask。

m_task.en: Task number, from 1 to M, in the average mR@k. Not the mask m_i of KP 07.
m_task.zh: 任務編號，從 1 到 M，用在平均 mR@k。不是 KP 07 的 mask m_i。

mid.en: Read 'such that' or 'where'. In {x | condition} the part after the bar is the condition each item must meet: in Eq. (3), steps i on the path; in Eq. (6), points whose pixel lies in the mask.
mid.src: Eq. (3), p.3 right; Eq. (6), p.4 right
mid.zh: 讀作「滿足」或「其中」。{x | 條件} 裡，直線後面是每個元素要滿足的條件：式 (3) 是在路徑上的步驟 i；式 (6) 是 pixel 落在 mask 裡的點。

n_fisher.en: All trials of both groups: a + b + c + d. For one product, 20 + 20 = 40. Not the n of Table 3 in KP 10.
n_fisher.zh: 兩組全部的試驗次數：a + b + c + d。一件產品是 20 + 20 = 40。不是 KP 10 表 3 的 n。

n_gt.en: Number of ground-truth triples of the task: the denominator of R. Our notation; the paper prints no formula for R.
n_gt.zh: 這個任務的 ground truth triple 條數：R 的分母。這是我們的記法；論文沒有印 R 的公式。

n_trials.en: Number of trials per step in Table 3.
n_trials.zh: 表 3 每一步試的次數。

nu.en: Visual input: an assembly drawing or a picture of the workspace.
nu.zh: 視覺輸入：組裝圖，或現場的畫面。

nu_prompt.en: The picture ν and the instruction text Prompt: the inputs of the Action Narrator besides ϱ.
nu_prompt.zh: 圖 ν 和指示文字 Prompt：Action Narrator 除了 ϱ 以外的輸入。

o_hat.en: Object of step i: the part the subject is joined onto.
o_hat.zh: 第 i 步的 object：subject 要接上去的那個零件。

o_key.en: Object of a triple in the key (s, p, o): the part it is joined onto.
o_key.zh: key (s, p, o) 裡 triple 的 object：接上去的那個零件。

one_h.en: The 1 added to a vector or a matrix: p = [u, v, 1], the last entry of [x, y, z, 1], and the corner of Γ_t. It lets one 4×4 matrix shift a point. In the example Γ_t, the 1 in the right column is a shift of 1 m along x.
one_h.src: Eq. (4)(5), p.4 right; the homogeneous 1 itself is External
one_h.zh: 加在向量或矩陣裡的那個 1：p = [u, v, 1]、[x, y, z, 1] 的最後一個數、Γ_t 的右下角。有了它，一個 4×4 矩陣就能平移一個點。例子的 Γ_t 右欄那個 1，是沿 x 平移 1 m。

p_bold.en: Homogeneous coordinate vector of pixel (u, v), read as [u, v, 1]ᵀ. The paper does not write it out.
p_bold.zh: pixel (u, v) 的齊次座標向量，讀作 [u, v, 1]ᵀ。論文沒有寫出來。

p_hat.en: Predicate of step i: the word for how the two parts join.
p_hat.zh: 第 i 步的 predicate：寫「怎麼接」的那個詞。

p_hat_rate.en: Observed success rate k/n of a step. Not the predicate p̂_i of KP 03.
p_hat_rate.zh: 一個步驟實際觀察到的成功率 k/n。不是 KP 03 的 predicate p̂_i。

p_i_point.en: In the ICP objective: one point of the disassembled cloud. Here i counts points.
p_i_point.zh: 在 ICP 目標式裡：拆開點雲的一個點。這裡的 i 數的是點。

p_key.en: Predicate of a triple in the key (s, p, o): the relation word. Not the p-value of KP 04.
p_key.zh: key (s, p, o) 裡 triple 的 predicate：關係詞。不是 KP 04 的 p 值。

q_i_point.en: In the ICP objective: the point of the assembled cloud closest to p_i under the current R and T.
q_i_point.zh: 在 ICP 目標式裡：照目前的 R、T，組好點雲裡離 p_i 最近的點。

r_chain.en: The chain of objects the Base Searcher returns, from r_1 to r_j. The paper does not define j.
r_chain.zh: Base Searcher 回的那一串物體，從 r_1 到 r_j。論文沒有定義 j。

r_j.en: An object present in the visual input. The count j is not defined.
r_j.src: Eq. (2) and the line under it, p.3 right
r_j.zh: 視覺輸入裡出現的一個物體。個數 j 沒有定義。

rightarrow.en: An arrow. In Eq. (3), σ → ϱ means 'from the base σ along the path ϱ'. In Eq. (2) the arrows link the objects of a chain. In KP 07 it means 'becomes': a 3-number point becomes a 4-number point.
rightarrow.src: Eq. (2)(3), p.3 right; the KP 07 arrow is ours
rightarrow.zh: 箭頭。式 (3) 的 σ → ϱ 是「從基準 σ 沿著路徑 ϱ」。式 (2) 的箭頭把一串物體連起來。KP 07 的箭頭是「變成」：3 個數的點變成 4 個數的點。

rxyz.en: Gripper rotation about x, y and z, as Euler angles: the three numbers of R. The axis order and the unit are not stated; our lab uses radians.
rxyz.zh: 夾爪繞 x、y、z 的轉角，用 Euler angles：R 的三個數。軸的順序和單位論文沒寫；我們的實驗室用 rad。

s_hat.en: Subject of step i: the part that is moved. The paper does not explain the hat; in common use it marks an estimate.
s_hat.zh: 第 i 步的 subject：被移動的零件。論文沒有解釋帽子；一般用法是「估計出來的」。

s_key.en: Subject of a triple in the key (s, p, o): the part that is moved.
s_key.zh: key (s, p, o) 裡 triple 的 subject：被移動的零件。

s_t.en: Binary grasping state: gripper open or closed.
s_t.zh: 二值的夾取狀態：夾爪開或合。

sigma.en: The assembly benchmark: the part from which assembly starts.
sigma.shape: one node; Fig. 2 shows three candidates
sigma.zh: assembly benchmark：開始組裝的那個零件。

spo_hat.en: Subject, predicate and object of step i. The hat is not explained in the paper; in common use it marks an estimate.
spo_hat.zh: 第 i 步的 subject、predicate、object。帽子論文沒有解釋；一般用法表示估計值。

sup_VLM.en: Superscript, not a power. VLM marks a call that receives the picture; LLM marks a text-only call. This is our reading of Eq. (1) to (3).
sup_VLM.zh: 上標，不是次方。VLM 標明這次呼叫有拿到圖；LLM 標明只給文字。這是我們對式 (1) 到 (3) 的讀法。

t_frame.en: Which camera observation or frame. Not the assembly step t of G_t in KP 02 and KP 05.
t_frame.zh: 第幾次相機觀測或第幾張畫面。不是 KP 02、KP 05 裡 G_t 的組裝步驟 t。

t_step.en: Time step of the plan: the number of the assembly step. Not seconds. The same letter marks camera time in §3.2.
t_step.src: §3.1, p.4 left; compare O_t, p.4 left
t_step.zh: 計劃的時間步：第幾個組裝步驟，不是秒。§3.2 用同一個字母標相機的時間。

theta.en: Rotation angle about the vertical axis that our lab's ICP has found so far. The lab reads R ≈ R_vertical(θ). Not in the paper.
theta.zh: 我們實驗室的 ICP 目前找到的、繞垂直軸的旋轉角。實驗室把 R 讀成 R_vertical(θ)。論文沒有。

times.en: Multiplication sign. In Γ_obj = Γ^c_b × Γ_grasp it is a matrix product of two 4×4 matrices. In Eq. (7), P × R is not defined by the paper.
times.zh: 乘號。Γ_obj = Γ^c_b × Γ_grasp 裡是兩個 4×4 矩陣相乘。式 (7) 的 P × R，論文沒有定義。

top.en: Transpose: turns a row into a column. [u, v, 1]^T is a column of three numbers. The paper does not write it; we add it to keep the shapes clear.
top.zh: 轉置：把一列變成一行。[u, v, 1]^T 是三個數排成一行。論文沒有寫，我們補上，讓形狀看得清楚。

trou_ex.en: Worked example: the second cloud was moved by (2, −1.5, 0.4), so the rough translation that brings it back is (−2.0, 1.5, −0.4). The numbers have no unit and were chosen to check the arithmetic.
trou_ex.zh: 例子：第二團點雲被平移 (2, −1.5, 0.4)，所以把它搬回來的粗平移是 (−2.0, 1.5, −0.4)。這些數沒有單位，是為了核對算術編的。

u_pix.en: Horizontal pixel coordinate (column), counted from the left. In the worked example u = 70 px.
u_pix.zh: pixel 的水平座標（欄），從左邊數起。例子裡 u = 70 px。

unit_deg.en: Degree. Our lab shows angles in degrees; it stores them in radians. The paper gives no unit.
unit_deg.zh: 度。我們的實驗室用度顯示角度，內部用 rad 存。論文沒有寫單位。

unit_m.en: Metre. The paper gives no unit; our lab and worked examples use metres.
unit_m.zh: 公尺。論文沒有寫單位；我們的實驗室和例子用公尺。

unit_mm.en: Millimetre. Our lab shows ICP error and waypoint segments in mm. The paper gives no unit.
unit_mm.zh: 毫米。我們的實驗室用 mm 顯示 ICP 誤差和路點每一段的長度。論文沒有寫單位。

unit_px.en: Pixel, as a unit: the entries of K are in pixels.
unit_px.zh: pixel 當單位：K 裡的元素單位是 pixel。

uv.en: Position of one pixel: u is the column and v is the row. Eq. (4) to (6) work one pixel at a time.
uv.src: §3.2, p.4 right; the column and row convention is External
uv.zh: 一個 pixel 的位置：u 是第幾欄，v 是第幾列。式 (4) 到 (6) 一次算一個 pixel。

v_pix.en: Vertical pixel coordinate (row), counted from the top. In the worked example v = 60 px.
v_pix.zh: pixel 的垂直座標（列），從上面數起。例子裡 v = 60 px。

varrho.en: A path through the graph, retrieved by the Base Searcher. The paper's example alternates objects and predicates.
varrho.shape: ordered list of names and predicates
varrho.zh: Base Searcher 從圖上取出的一條路徑。論文的例子是物體和 predicate 交替排列。

varrho_sigma.en: ϱ is the path through the stage-1 graph; σ is the base the path starts from.
varrho_sigma.zh: ϱ 是階段 1 的圖上的一條路徑；σ 是這條路徑開始的基準。

w_i.en: The waypoints of Eq. (7), counted from w_0 = P to w_5 = P + T. The names w_i are ours. In the lab's counting w_1 is P × R as printed, with the position unchanged.
w_i.src: Eq. (7), p.5 left; the names are ours
w_i.zh: 式 (7) 的路點，從 w_0 = P 數到 w_5 = P + T。w_i 這些名字是我們取的。照實驗室的數法，w_1 是印刷的 P × R，位置不變。

w_img.en: Image width in pixels. The paper gives no value; our lab uses 640.
w_img.zh: 影像寬度，單位 pixel。論文沒有給數值；我們的實驗室用 640。

wp3_calc.en: Worked example: P + 0.8 T written coordinate by coordinate, with P = (0.10, −0.20, 0.30) m and T = (0, 0.05, −0.12) m.

wp3_val.en: Worked example: the third waypoint P + 0.8 T.
wp3_val.zh: 例子：第三個路點 P + 0.8 T。

wp4_val.en: Worked example: the fourth waypoint P + 0.92 T.
wp4_val.zh: 例子：第四個路點 P + 0.92 T。

wp5_val.en: Worked example: the fifth waypoint P + 0.96 T.
wp5_val.zh: 例子：第五個路點 P + 0.96 T。

wp6_val.en: Worked example: the sixth waypoint P + T, the grasp point itself.
wp6_val.zh: 例子：第六個路點 P + T，也就是夾取點本身。

x_cam.en: First coordinate of the 3D point in camera coordinates: x = (u − c_x) d / f_x. x points right. Not the x of Fisher's test in KP 04.
x_cam.zh: 3D 點在相機座標裡的第一個座標：x = (u − c_x) d / f_x。x 向右。不是 KP 04 費雪檢定的 x。

x_fisher.en: A possible value of a: the successes that land in the 'without base' group when the a + c total successes are dealt at random to two groups of 20. For Product 5 it runs from 2 to 20.
x_fisher.zh: a 可能出現的值：把 a + c 次成功隨機分給兩組（各 20 次）時，落在「沒有 base」那組的成功數。Product 5 是 2 到 20。

y_cam.en: Second coordinate of the 3D point in camera coordinates: y = (v − c_y) d / f_y. y points down.
y_cam.zh: 3D 點在相機座標裡的第二個座標：y = (v − c_y) d / f_y。y 向下。

z_cam.en: Third coordinate of the 3D point in camera coordinates. It equals the depth d, and points forward.
z_cam.zh: 3D 點在相機座標裡的第三個座標，等於深度 d，向前。

zeta_i.en: 3D object instance of part i: its point cloud, its label and box, its mask. A node of the low-level graph.
zeta_i.zh: 零件 i 的 3D object instance：點雲、標籤與框、mask。是低層圖的節點。

zeta_i_alone.en: 3D object instance of part i: its point cloud, its label with box, its mask.
zeta_i_alone.zh: 零件 i 的 3D object instance：點雲、標籤與框、mask。

zeta_i_dis.en: Instance of part i in the disassembled state. The one that is moved.
zeta_i_dis.zh: 零件 i 在拆開狀態的 instance。被搬動的那一個。

zeta_i_s.en: Instance of part i in the assembled state. Target of the alignment.
zeta_i_s.zh: 零件 i 在組好狀態的 instance。對齊的目標。
